title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) & Clean Architecture Mastery
description: Master core object-oriented principles, design patterns, clean code practices, and scalable software architecture.

phases.title: Core OOP Pillars
phases.description: The four foundational pillars of object-oriented design.

topics.name: Encapsulation & Data Hiding
topics.description: Private fields, public getters/setters, state integrity, and immutability practices.

topics.name: Abstraction & Interfaces
topics.description: Hiding implementation details, abstract classes vs interfaces, modular decoupling.

topics.name: Inheritance vs Composition
topics.description: Class hierarchies, the 'is-a' vs 'has-a' relationship, and avoiding deep inheritance trees.

topics.name: Polymorphism (Static vs Dynamic)
topics.description: Method overloading, method overriding, dynamic dispatch, and virtual tables.

phases.title: SOLID Principles
phases.description: Five principles for writing maintainable and resilient software.

topics.name: Single Responsibility Principle (SRP)
topics.description: Cohesion vs coupling, identifying reasons to change, refactoring god classes.

topics.name: Open/Closed Principle (OCP)
topics.description: Extending functionality through abstraction without modifying existing source code.

topics.name: Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP)
topics.description: Subtype substitutability, contract invariants, behavioral subtyping, and common violations.

topics.name: Interface Segregation & Dependency Inversion (ISP & DIP)
topics.description: Role-specific interfaces, dependency injection containers, and inversion of control.

phases.title: Creational & Structural Design Patterns
phases.description: Proven design patterns for object creation and structural composition.

topics.name: Factory Method & Abstract Factory
topics.description: Encapsulating object instantiation logic and supporting family objects.

topics.name: Singleton & Builder Patterns
topics.description: Thread-safe lazy initialization, step-by-step complex object construction.

topics.name: Adapter, Decorator & Proxy Patterns
topics.description: Wrapping legacy classes, dynamic behavior extension, and access control proxies.

phases.title: Behavioral Design Patterns
phases.description: Managing object communication and control flow.

topics.name: Observer & Event-Driven Architecture
topics.description: Publish-subscribe pattern, subject-observer decoupling, event buses.

topics.name: Strategy & State Patterns
topics.description: Swappable algorithms at runtime, state machine implementation without giant switch statements.

topics.name: Chain of Responsibility & Command
topics.description: Decoupling senders and receivers, request queues, undo/redo command logs.
